claims.claim_vi: A year has 8,760 hours; 99.9% availability allows about 8.76 h of downtime a year, 99.99% about 52.6 min; two independent services in series at 99.9% each give 0.999 x 0.999, about 99.8%.
Availability and reliability are different: a service can answer always yet answer wrongly.
